1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.Nf3 Bb4 4.g4.strategy: An aggressive pawn lunge: White grabs kingside space and threatens to chase the f6-knight away, but it loosens its own king before castling and the pawn can be taken. White must justify it with activity and a lead in development, so it is a risky, offbeat choice.
1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.Nf3 Bb4 4.g4.name: English Opening: Anglo-Indian Defence, Zvjaginsev-Krasenkow Attack
